accountsBody: Ikigo cyawe ni cyo gishinzwe konti zacyo: uwatumiwe, inshingano ahabwa, no gukuraho uburenganzira igihe umuntu agiye. Amakuru yo kwinjira ntagomba gusangirwa. Kwemeza mu ntambwe ebyiri birahari kandi turagusaba kubikoresha kuri konti z'abayobozi.
availabilityBody: Tugamije ko serivisi iboneka igihe cyose ariko ntitwiyemeza ko itazigera ihagarara. Ibikorwa byo kuyisana biteganywa hanze y'amasaha y'ishuri aho bishoboka. Serivisi itangwa uko iri, nta cyemezo ko itazagira amakosa.
backupsBody: Banki y'amakuru ibikwa ku bundi buryo buri joro. Ubwo bubiko ni ingamba zo kwirinda amakosa yacu, si ibisimbura imicungire y'inyandiko zawe: ubike kopi zawe z'ibyo amategeko agusaba kubika.
changesBody: Dushobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza. Impinduka zifatika zimenyeshwa ibigo mbere y'igihe. Gukomeza gukoresha serivisi nyuma y'impinduka bivuze kwemera amabwiriza yavuguruwe.
closing: Aya mabwiriza yanditswe mu magambo yoroshye kugira ngo yumvikane, atari ugutangaza. Ntabwo asimbura inama y'umunyamategeko, kandi agomba gusuzumwa n'umunyamategeko mbere yo kuyashingiraho mu masezerano y'ubucuruzi.
dataBody: Inyandiko zose z'abanyeshuri, ababyeyi n'abakozi ikigo cyawe cyinjiza zikomeza kuba iz'ikigo. Ikigo cyawe ni cyo gishinzwe ayo makuru; twe tuyakoresha dukurikije amabwiriza yawe kugira ngo dutange serivisi. Ntitwayagurisha, kandi ntitwayakoresha mu kwamamaza. Reba
endingBody: Ikigo gishobora guhagarika gukoresha Imboni igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Nugisaba mu gihe gikwiye nyuma yo kugenda, tuzaguha kopi y'amakuru y'ikigo cyawe hanyuma tuyasibe. Dushobora guhagarika cyangwa gufunga konti irenga aya mabwiriza, kandi tukavuga impamvu.
lawBody: Aya masezerano agengwa n'amategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda.
liabilityBody: Mu rugero amategeko yemera, inshingano zacu zigarukira ku mafaranga yishyuwe kuri serivisi mu mezi cumi n'abiri mbere y'ikirego. Ntidushinzwe igihombo kitaziguye cyangwa gikomoka ku kindi. Nta na kimwe muri aya mabwiriza kigabanya inshingano amategeko atemera ko zagabanywa.
partiesBody: Aya masezerano ari hagati ya Imboni Education n'ikigo gifungura konti. Uwiyandikisha yemeza ko afite ububasha bwo kuyagirana mu izina ry'ikigo.
paymentBody: Gahunda zishyurwa zishyurwa mbere y'igihe cyumvikanyweho. Konti nitinda kwishyura, tuzabimenyesha ku rubuga mbere yo gufata ikindi cyemezo. Nitikomeza kutishyurwa igihe cy'ubuntu kirangiye, konti irahagarikwa, bivuze ko abakozi bacyashobora kwinjira bakishyura umwenda ariko ibindi byose bya sisitemu ntibiboneke. Guhagarikwa ntibisiba amakuru.
plansBodyEnd: Kugera ku mubare ntarengwa bibuza kongeramo abanyeshuri cyangwa abakozi bashya; ntibisiba ikintu na kimwe kandi ntibibuza kugera ku nyandiko zisanzwe muri sisitemu. Konti z'ababyeyi ni ubuntu kandi ntizibarwa.
